description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Check structured output before you use or send it. Give the raw text (a model reply works: set extract to pull the JSON out of ```json fences or surrounding prose) or the parsed data, and optionally a JSON Schema. Returns valid / invalid with every problem and its JSON Pointer path (e.g. /items/2/price: must be >= 0), or the line and column of a syntax error. Supports type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items/prefixItems, min/max (length, items, properties), uniqueItems, contains, minimum/maximum/exclusive, multipleOf (exact decimals), pattern, format (email, date, date-time, time, uri, uuid, ipv4, ipv6, hostname) asserted, allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, if/then/else and local $ref. Up to 100 errors listed.

data.description: the value itself, already parsed (instead of text)

extract.description: pull the JSON out of surrounding text: a ```json block, else the first {...} or [...]

schema.description: a JSON Schema; omit to only check that the text is valid JSON

text.description: the JSON as text (or a model reply containing it, with extract: true)

name: json_check
title: Is this JSON valid and does it match the schema? (exact errors with paths)
